title: The Flattering Test
prompt:
**Scenario.** Your greedy passed 300 random tests with distinct values. Which input shape have you NOT tested at all?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Large inputs

**B)** All-ties — random distinct data never creates equal keys, so tie-break code has zero coverage

**C)** Negative numbers

**D)** Sorted input

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Distinct-value randomness structurally excludes ties: every comparison-branch variant for equal keys is untested. Generate the tie storm on purpose.
